primary_meaning: The Messiah/Christ as the singular promised offspring who fulfills the covenant promises made to the woman, Abraham, and David

alternatives.meaning: The word/gospel of God sown into human hearts
Physical or spiritual descendants/offspring in general
Christ (or the believer) dying like a grain of wheat in order to produce fruit
The righteous remnant or the church itself as the product of divine sowing

notes: Multiple context-dependent meanings are firmly established in Christian biblical interpretation; the messianic/covenantal sense is the most theologically central for the capitalized or absolute use of 'Seed,' while the parable-of-the-sower sense is equally common in teaching on the gospel.
